name: Call of Heresy
notes: Heresy is its own stack, not negative Favor: normal raise +1, elite +2, boss +3; at 5 Heresy you can't raise. Raising is blocked only once you're at 5 or more, so an elite or boss raised at 3-4 Heresy can take you past 5 (a boss at 4 makes 7). Heresy's buff icon swaps at 5+ (raising blocked) to a different one: one stack whose icon changes, not two stacks. Heresy carries from floor to floor and resets in town. It goes down only through Sacrificial Penance (Necrotic Resurrection at 5 Favor) and the Pyre Sacrifice orb. Lunge: rolled once per intact body, the first time you come within range of it. You suddenly lunge at it and consume its flesh: a 3 s channel that cancels whatever you're casting and blocks all abilities until it ends, and uses up the body. While you eat, your health regeneration rises by 50 per second. Choosing the spec gives Divine Favor level 1 for free. An intact body is a gray version of the enemy lying on its side (a boss's stands upright, gray). Bodies stay on the ground for 60 s. Level numbers are a first pass.
summary: Slain enemies have a chance to fall with their body intact, ready for Necrotic Resurrection. Heresy, gained by raising the dead, stacks up: each stack makes your summons stronger, but raises the chance that you lunge at an intact body you come near and consume its flesh, a 3 s channel that cancels and blocks all your abilities but gives +50 health regeneration per second while it lasts.
